notes.title: Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight Update 10/7/15
notes.notes:
10/7 Update - Additional Mouse Support and Trading Cards Now Available!

 Patch Notes: 
         - Mouse support is now available throughout the game with the exception of multiplayer mode, which still requires a controllers or keyboard.
         - Trading Cards now available!
         

Coming Soon:
         - Multiplayer mouse support along with the ability to use the enter key are coming shortly.  
         
        
Thanks for Playing!

notes.title: Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight Update 9/28/15
notes.notes:
9/28 Update - We’ve now added partial mouse support for Gem movement and Power-ups! 

Info: Menu navigation at launch, and between levels still requires the keyboard right now.  
 
 Patch Notes: Game updated with partial mouse support
         - In-Level Gem Movements
         - In-Level Power-up Activation
         -Other miscellaneous bug-fixes

Some Q&A from the community

Q: Will you have Steam cards?
A: Coming soon!

Q: Will you have Enter Key use? 
A: The ability to use the enter key will be part of the full mouse control update coming soon.

Thanks for Playing!

notes.title: Frozen Free Fall: Snowball Fight Update 9/28/15
notes.notes:
We’re now added partial mouse support for Gem movement and Power-ups.  Menu navigation at launch and between levels still requires the keyboard functionality for right now.  That fix is coming shortly.
 
 Patch Notes: Game updated with partial mouse support
         - In-Level Gem Movements
         - In-Level Power-up Activation
         -Other miscellaneous bug-fixes

Some Q&A from the community

Q: Will you have Steam cards?
A: Coming soon!

Q: Will you have Enter Key 
A: It's not ready quite yet. We hope this will be part of 'phase 2 'mouse control improvement. This would help put mouse controls across the entire app.  [Mapping enter is part of the dev team work to put mouse controls across the entire app.]


Thanks for Playing!
